_note_test_command: DELIBERATELY ABSENT. The stop-dod-gate hook runs test_command on EVERY Stop event -- and Stop fires once per assistant turn, not once per session (measured: 2506 executions across 23 sessions). This suite takes 280s against the hook's own 60s cap, so it would time out every single turn: fail-open, zero guarantee, 60s added to every reply. Arming this gate needs a fast subset (<20s) chosen on purpose, not the full suite. Tracked as part of phase 4.
